svg.title: SMC reset distribution
svg.desc: Reset distribution inside the SMC. Boundary inputs enter on the left. u_smc_reset_unit, in u_smc_peripherals, builds rst_primary_smc_clk_no, rst_primary_periph_clk_no, rst_warm_smc_clk_no and rst_cold_stable_smc_clk_no from the boundary resets and fuse_reset_n, which u_smc_efuse_wrapper releases once fuse sensing completes and u_ext_boot_seq_done_qual reports the external boot sequence done. rst_primary_smc_clk_no resets u_smc_base, the rest of u_smc_peripherals, u_smc_cpu_wrapper, the CPU_CTRL registers in u_smc_cpu_ctrl_wrap and the cluster AXI isolates, through u_smc_cpu rst_isolate_ni. rst_primary_periph_clk_no resets the I2C, UART, I3C and AVSBus register logic and the peripheral-clock side of u_smc_peripherals_cdc. rst_warm_smc_clk_no resets the warm scratch register and the core and uncore reset flops in u_smc_cpu_ctrl_wrap, which register the core and uncore reset requests from the RESET_CTRL logic. rst_cold_stable_smc_clk_no resets u_ext_boot_seq_done_qual and the GPIO interfaces. fuse_reset_n resets the scratch RAM zero-fill. These flops drive cluster_uncore_reset_n, which resets u_tilelink_to_rom_memory_convert, the uncore of u_digital_top, the cluster boundary flops and the four watchdogs, and core_reset_n[3:0], which, ANDed with zero-fill completion and the inverted hart reset request into int_rst_core_n[3:0], resets each Rocket tile. The RESET_CTRL logic drives debug_reset_n, which resets the debug module. The gated core reset int_rst_core_n reaches each watchdog's wdt_n_corerst as a status input, not as a reset. smc_cpu_jtag_reset_i resets the debug transport module and rst_telemetry_ni the telemetry side of u_telemetry_receiver_wrap.
